## 主张 Claim

不同片段载体的有限配置若初始位置数相同且对保留引用的全部分支问题同测，在固定输入对有限结果条件下，每个有限形成命令序列都有相应历史，保留原配置、同测结果及位置对齐。同一实际过程的精确说明必须区分空历史与已消耗历史。 / Finite configurations over different fragment carriers with equal initial slot counts and agreement on all retained-reference branch questions match every finite formation command sequence under finite fixed-pair outcomes, preserving the original configuration, final answers and slot alignment. Exact accounts of the same actual process must distinguish its idle and spent histories.

Canonical source: [ExplanatoryJoiningRegisters.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryJoiningRegisters.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 两侧 FiniteOutcomes；全部有限否定、合取与位置对接续问题同测；相同初始位置数。 / FiniteOutcomes on both sides; agreement on all finite negation, conjunction and slot-pair continuation questions; equal initial slot counts.
- 每步从同一配置选择两个位置并追加有见证的结果，原位置保持不变。不可抹去区别的具体定理只需 Exact，不需有限性或 Reduced。 / Each step selects two slots in the same configuration and appends a witnessed result while retaining old slots. The concrete unavoidable-distinction theorem only needs Exact, not finiteness or Reduced.

编号是配置内部位置，可引用之前形成的结果；没有共同原生对象名。形成安排语义不自动是破坏性资源的实际执行。 / Indices name positions internal to the configuration and can reference earlier formed results; no common native object names are supplied. Formation-arrangement semantics is not automatically execution with destructive resources.
